oldProfiles.intro: A familiar home where Kari and Tai balance homework, family concern and a small dinosaur's appetite.
Classrooms and a guarded computer room support ordinary school life and D-3 gate departures.
Ferries, bridges and warehouses offer public rescue routes and evidence of a new broadcast.

A busy civilian hub where a lost egg can disappear without a grand battle.

A fortified mountain route tests discipline and transparent intentions.

Access to the center needs all four domains' informed cooperation.
Aki Minase coordinates refugees, ferries, archives and practical supplies.
Eggs retain viable cores but their bond-signatures and shell patterns have disappeared.
Leaves store incomplete accounts that need human and Digimon testimony to interpret.
Messages to missing partners wash ashore as recoverable fragments.
Original antagonist headquarters hides its erased grief under immaculate architecture.
The final archive safeguards recordings without owning the people remembered.
An optional historical Internet crisis supports multi-site coordination against Diaboromon.
Residual copies can be isolated without assuming every harmless packet is an enemy.

Meiko, Meicoomon, infections and institutional secrecy form an ethical investigation.
A beautiful captivity preserves childhood at the cost of consent and present lives.
Rui and Ukkomon's wish crisis produces a difficult investigation of partnership.

A bounded classifier test can reveal one error without proving the whole theory. Repair must protect verified life, agency and a dependable stop-and-return procedure.
An original keeper site tests trustworthy cooperation without taking Davis's established relic or Matt's personal Crest. Allies retain their own choices and practical limits.
A damaged return beacon may explain why a friend failed to come back on time. Test the evidence before deciding they abandoned the party.
A campaign shrine values honest uncertainty, correction and care in speaking truth. The authentic Armor relic and the established Crest naming conventions retain separate records.
An honest confession may omit another person's contribution. Seek an independent account and let the witness revise it voluntarily.
A campaign rescue shrine asks for commitments the party can actually sustain. Cody's relic and partnership remain intact unless a selected source state establishes different custody.
A completed rescue report may hide borrowed supplies never returned. Account for real stock and affected people rather than awarding virtue for an unsupported promise.

This campaign extension provides a keeper for the wider-franchise Kindness Armor relic; it is not a claimed televised shrine visit. Ken's canonical Crest remains distinct.
A caregiver may have accepted Choir help without knowing its hidden procedure. Check actual knowledge and present choices before assigning guilt or attempting a repair.
Managed meat plants provide finite food through seeds, ripe stock and willing caretakers. Irrigation, fair portions and suitable partner diets can make a useful quest.

A quiet care stop assesses an actual resting partner after travel or evolution. Wild adults are not forced into Rookie to receive aid, and a weakened child may need a specialist.

An actual willing Whamon or suitable vessel agrees to a named crossing, capacity and return. A remembered episode is not a permanent summon or authority over every Whamon.
A missed meeting may reflect current, injury or a wrong time. Verify a shore witness and operator message; a repair can earn one agreed passage.
Rain channels and tended beds support willing personal accounts beside food and shelter work. This original virtue site does not automatically hold Mimi's Crest or an Armor relic.
Two honest deliveries may use the same mark. Compare their actual senders and contents before calling a caretaker a liar.

Rescue teams maintain an inspected bridge, limited shelter and actual return beacons. Medicine delivery and safe route repair demonstrate sustainable commitments without automatically granting a Crest.
A late crew may have used its reserve to rescue a second traveler. Compare both accounts and account for supplies before judging the schedule.
Qualified helpers ask what a survivor actually wants restored and what stays private. Care does not require forgiveness, faction membership or returning to an archive's preferred past identity.
Separate imposed actions and later voluntary choices in a former guard's account. Protect the patient and community without demanding instant absolution.
Labeled parts and preserved failures support Aki Minase's accountable repair work. Her former Choir experience offers specific leads and difficult questions, not omniscience.
Aki can admit a knowledge gap while a failed repair reveals a later modification. Compare dated notes and the actual component before deciding how much to trust.

Workers isolate the Choir's actual recognition-erasing Blank Spires while protecting a nearby community. They are distinct from Emperor evolution suppression, and defeating a patrol does not disable every tower.
One repaired spire may help locally while another sends altered indexes. Measure both and record who still needs care or a bounded repair.

A quiet outpost helps newcomers and developing children prepare for their first safe journey. A potential bond, living egg and compatible device response are established through the selected start and real choices.
A responding device need not announce a fixed destiny. Record the actual child, earned stage and voluntary partnership; independent Digimon need no assigned human owner.
Families count meals, water, bandages, maps and suitable spare parts for actual expeditions. Ordinary household tools can be useful without becoming miraculous artifacts.
An extra nursery blanket can reveal a delivery for a child missing from a request list. Verify the caretaker and custody rather than assigning the egg to the player.
An invited room gives a small partner food, quiet and a practical referral away from Tokyo crowds. The host cannot accommodate every large body or diagnose every core condition.
Ask before changing a chosen nickname to match an older record. Rest can support a difficult decision without forcing a former identity or refilling every resource.
Lantern volunteers maintain one measured Dark Ocean route with an independent outside anchor. Their work does not explain the whole realm or make every fogbound path safe.
A failed anchor may mean the outside keeper lost power. Check both endpoints before concluding the realm rejected a traveler.
A dated field station separates human wounds, Digimon core needs, device damage and actual Digisoul expenditure. Qualified care can require postponing redeployment.
A returnee may remember an order missing from the official briefing. Preserve permitted logs and independent testimony while care continues without requiring another mission.

A qualified clinic distinguishes materialized patients, device representations and affected humans after a dated Ghost Game incident. Visibility changes are not automatically healing, death or evolution.
A supposed curse may involve one Digimon's actual ability and grievance. Compare timing and willing accounts before treatment or negotiation.
Operators repair compatible Appmon devices and verify valid willing App Fusion pairs. Standard, Super, Ultimate and God remain source grades rather than automatic Adventure stage equivalents.
A device can fail because permission was honestly revoked. Ask the actual owner and check a signed counterrecord before restoring access.
Authorized backups support one bounded application recovery. Records, simulations and living Appmon are different subjects, and a restored service does not manufacture a whole personality or consent.
A user may want one function restored while refusing old personal data. Respect the signed scope; a missing file alone does not prove Leviathan involvement.
Counted food, care supplies and discreet routes support actual source refugees. Shelter does not qualify a visitor for an X-Antibody variant or compel disclosure of vulnerable identities.
A shortage may result from an honest unplanned rescue. Verify recipients and stock before alleging theft or demanding a battle pledge.
An actual dated Knight representative has individual orders and authority. A petition or escort agreement has explicit limits and does not award rank or unrestricted system access.
Two authentic orders may belong to different source states. Date both and ask the current representative before directing an escort or force.
Permitted Liberator match records distinguish decks, avatars and actual living partners. Reviewing a replay does not acquire another player's roster or printed card abilities.
An authentic replay can display a handle changed later. Compare dates and account authentication before declaring erasure or cheating.

roles.home: Visits follow the household's invitation and daily routine. Food, homework, family concerns and privacy shape the scene. A small partner can rest where agreed; a large temporary form needs safe outside space. A borrowed object remains its owner's property.
roles.school: Classes, staff permission and ordinary students shape access. A gate attempt needs a verified destination, working terminal and compatible device. Restricted rooms stay locked until a specific authorized or established emergency route exists. An evacuation needs a real headcount.
roles.clinic: Treatment begins with the actual patient and condition, qualified knowledge, finite supplies and consent. Human medicine, device repair and Digimon core care have different limits. Reversion preserves wounds, fatigue, status and expenditure; recovery takes the actual treatment and time.
roles.nursery: Living hatching and rebirth Digitama need provenance, warmth, quiet and careful custody. They are distinct from Armor Digi-Eggs. A developing child follows its real Fresh and In-Training lineage; neither a visitor nor a keeper automatically owns it or guarantees its future forms.
roles.town: Residents offer work, trade and introductions within their actual capabilities. Recruitment needs agreement, supplies and a suitable role. A town worker remains an individual; service, friendship and a bonded tamer partnership are separate choices. Food and shelter have real capacity.
roles.market: Stock, prices, hours and willing traders determine what is available. Add purchases only through the actual inventory records. Food, repair parts and suitable recovery supplies can matter as much as a rare relic. Pictures, promises and replicas do not grant the depicted item.
roles.training: Practice uses the participant's actual body, learned moves and suitable equipment, with rest and stop conditions. Evolution needs a compatible bonded Digivice, an earned route, consent and resources. Once Rookie is learned, ordinary temporary forms return to that recorded base with expenditure intact; severe exhaustion and established species exceptions are tracked separately. Qualified Ultra is a campaign apex label with a bounded short scene or three decisive actions and recorded fatigue; preserve each form's actual published stage. Armor, Hybrid, DNA and modes are separate qualified routes.
roles.workshop: Repairs require diagnosis, compatible parts, permission and time. Original Digivices, D-3s, D-Terminals and later source devices retain distinct functions. A copied signature is evidence to test, not a universal key. Preserve an original before changing a component or record.
roles.shrine: A genuine Armor Digi-Egg/Digimental needs authentic custody, a compatible existing partner, an earned route, a suitable bonded device, consent and resources. A living egg, Crest and Digimental are different subjects. Virtue is demonstrated through meaningful choices, not possession of a decorative symbol.
roles.guardian: Protected audiences, restricted roads and inner seals stay locked until the actual warden's conditions are satisfied. A guardian can delegate or refuse a request. Evidence, practical help and an honest petition can matter more than fighting; a rare Crest or strong body confers no automatic authority.
roles.fortress: Defended interiors require a specific safe entry, identified threat and extraction plan. Historical villains appear only in a selected dated expedition or an evidenced surviving threat. Rescue, investigation, negotiation and careful repair can be objectives besides assault.
roles.archive: Records, simulations, preserved voices and living cores are distinct findings. Compare dates, provenance, independent witnesses and consent before restoration. Recovering information does not manufacture affection, automatically resurrect everyone named in it or overwrite a survivor's present identity.
roles.network: Entry establishes whose body or representation has crossed, what stays outside and how return works. Routing, authentication and finite bandwidth matter. A normal phone, terminal or Digivice is not a universal teleport, and familiar-looking messages can be forged.
roles.transit: Departure needs a named operating route, willing transport or authenticated gate, suitable capacity and a return plan. An atlas position does not turn distant countries or separate continuities into neighboring streets. Plan for the partner's resting body after a costly temporary evolution.
roles.wilderness: Pack food, water, terrain protection and a workable retreat. Flight, swimming, digging and climbing need actual capable bodies or suitable equipment. A biome does not grant species immunities. Combat uses the current profile: Vaccine has advantage over Virus, Virus over Data, and Data over Vaccine; attribute is not morality.

oldQuests.DATS Headquarters: Verify a forged assignment against command and the actual field contact; Digisoul and Burst routes remain source-specific.
oldQuests.Yggdrasil Access Frontier: A stale system order and a living host's consent differ; verify the actual source state and representative.
oldQuests.Green Zone Assembly: Assembly consent and supply tallies can trace a missing participant without duplicating partners or permanent component moves.
oldQuests.Bagra Fortress Border: Authenticate a rescue order's routing before committing the team; date the actual Bagra command structure.
oldQuests.DigiQuartz Crossing: Record Quartz entry and exit before interpreting a missing ordinary camera record as recognition erasure.
oldQuests.Hazakura Academy: A recording may omit a presence because of actual materialization conditions; compare source device and physical effects.
oldQuests.Hologram Market: A misunderstood food or visibility request can be negotiated; unfamiliar appearance does not create a villain.
oldQuests.Appmon Terminal Square: Validate an app permission independently; Standard, Super, Ultimate and God are distinct from Adventure stages.
oldQuests.X-Antibody Refuge: Protect refugee identities while verifying antibody qualification; an X suffix is not blanket superiority or immunity.
oldQuests.Liberator Contact Arena: Use actual legal match decks and replays; a pictured card cannot supply an unearned living Mega partner.
oldQuests.Seekers Archive: Separate dated Seekers records from a live source visit; compatible Mindlink requires the actual willing partner.

lore.Digi-Egg Shrine of Courage: Veemon's compatible Courage Armor route leads to Flamedramon under its actual requirements. The Armor Digi-Egg is separate from Tai's Crest and any living Digitama.
lore.Digi-Egg Shrine of Love: Hawkmon's compatible Love route leads to Halsemon under its actual requirements. This artifact is distinct from Sora's Crest and does not give every partner flight.
lore.Digi-Egg Shrine of Knowledge: Armadillomon's compatible Knowledge route leads to Digmon under its actual requirements. This artifact is distinct from Izzy's Crest; cleverness alone grants no form.
lore.Digi-Egg Shrine of Hope and Light: Patamon's compatible Hope route leads to Pegasusmon; Gatomon's compatible Light route leads to Nefertimon. The two relics and custodians stay distinct. Gatomon's established normal Champion base remains its exception.
lore.Digi-Egg Shrine of Friendship: Veemon's compatible Friendship route leads to Raidramon, also called Lighdramon. Genuine relic custody and the earned device route are required; Matt's Crest is a different object.
lore.Digi-Egg Shrine of Sincerity: Hawkmon's compatible Sincerity route leads to Shurimon. Preserve the chosen translation aliases in item records rather than inventing another original Adventure Crest.
lore.Digi-Egg Shrine of Reliability: Armadillomon's compatible Reliability route leads to Submarimon. Aquatic capability belongs to the actual form; human passengers still need suitable breathing and safe transport.
lore.Digi-Egg Shrine of Kindness: This is a campaign site for the wider-franchise Kindness Armor relic, not a claim that the televised team visited this shrine. Ken's canonical personal Crest and a documented compatible Armor route remain separate.
lore.Miracles Rescue Sanctuary: Veemon's golden Miracles route can lead to Magnamon, an Armor form. The personal Crest of Miracles is a campaign addition distinct from the genuine golden Armor Digi-Egg.
lore.Destiny Crossroads: Terriermon's golden Armor Rapidmon is distinct from green Ultimate Rapidmon. The personal Crest of Destiny is a campaign addition distinct from the golden Digimental. Poyomon lineage alone grants no compatible golden route.
lore.Golden Keeper Pilgrim House: Personal Miracles and Destiny Crest progress is original campaign content and does not replace the golden Armor relics. A genuine artifact, compatible earned route and involved partner's choice are separate requirements.
lore.Crest Ruins: The original Adventure eight Crests and Ken's Kindness keep their actual histories. Personal Miracles and Destiny Crest paths are campaign additions, separate from the two golden Armor Digi-Eggs.
lore.Nanomon Pyramid: Nanomon and Datamon are naming variants; resolve the actual NPC identity rather than inventing two duplicate canonical villains. A surviving current threat and the historical kidnapping are distinct dated states.
lore.Datamon Relay Hospital: The clinic's staff are original campaign individuals, not an automatic replay of the pyramid villain. An actual diagnosis separates a broken device from an injured living core.
lore.Digimon Emperor Fortress: Ken's Emperor past does not automatically restore his villain role. Historical fortress and Kimeramon events require a dated expedition; present control remnants need their own evidence.
lore.Colorado Summer Memory: Choose the original or dubbed film interpretation and date explicitly. Willis, Terriermon and Kokomon retain their source history. Golden Armor Rapidmon is distinct from ordinary green Ultimate Rapidmon.
lore.Our War Game Network: Omnimon requires its actual compatible consenting components and route. The historical event belongs to its established partners; Imperialdramon Paladin Mode has distinct later power-transfer conditions.
lore.D-Reaper Quarantine: D-Reaper is not simply a normal Virus-attribute Digimon. Source-specific agents and hazards require their actual diagnosis, protection and intervention rather than a blanket Vaccine counter.
lore.tri. Odaiba Archive: Choose the installment and actual dated state. Film infection, quarantine and reboot mechanisms do not automatically affect the Adventure 02 present or every Virus-attribute partner.
lore.Kizuna Memory Sphere: Choose whether entry reaches a simulation, preserved representation or living source state. A visit does not impose a blanket age countdown or forced separation on unrelated campaign partnerships.
lore.The Beginning Egg Canopy: Rui and Ukkomon retain their dated history. Egg manifestations require identification, and Ukkomon's claims are attributed evidence rather than an unquestioned origin of every Digimon bond.
lore.Dark Ocean Shore: The campaign adds safe-route procedures without declaring the show's unresolved realm origin solved. An entity's demand cannot compel a player's consent, relationship or permanent transformation.
lore.Deep One Settlement: This settlement is a campaign adaptation; its atlas label does not prove every inhabitant belongs to one confirmed canonical species or shares a collective mind.
lore.Seekers Archive: This existing archive stays in Liberator and New Horizons for compatibility. Live Seekers expeditions use Seekers Urban Network. Mindlink requires actual source-compatible devices, a willing partner and monitored limits.
lore.First Light Observatory: The campaign's restoration mechanism is not the declared origin of all continuities. A successful bounded repair preserves a living subject's present consent, scars and relationships.
lore.Choir's White Citadel: The original Null Choir project under Dr. Nao Tsukishiro contains distinct Mercy, Silence and Witness wings. Individual staff can disagree or defect; alleged relief never substitutes for informed consent.
lore.Aki's Lantern Workshop: Aki Minase's former Choir connection is earned through evidence and accountable conversation. She is available only when the active scene places her here and cannot answer every mystery.
lore.Deep Maintenance Threshold: The ancient maintenance theory remains unresolved. A successful bounded test cannot authorize global deletion, universal resurrection, forced bonds or control of all digital worlds.

protocols.Tamers Shinjuku: Tamers cards and Biomerge need their actual source-compatible system, participants and earned conditions. They are not automatically enabled on an Adventure Digivice.
protocols.Frontier Spirit Trails: Human, Beast and combined Spirit forms are distinct source protocols for eligible actual participants. Riding Trailmon or entering a shrine does not award a Spirit.
protocols.Data Squad and DATS: Digisoul and Burst routes need the chosen source's actual requirements and costs; a visitor's original device does not gain them automatically.
protocols.Fusion and Hunters Zones: DigiXros uses valid compatible consenting participants and proper release records. DigiQuartz entry and local capture rules are distinct source systems.
protocols.Ghost Game Hologram City: Visibility and materialization depend on the actual source device and individual ability. Appearance alone does not establish intangibility, safety, evolution or moral allegiance.
protocols.Appmon Network: Standard, Super, Ultimate and God are Appmon grades, distinct from Adventure stages. App Fusion needs its actual valid pairing and compatible source hardware.
protocols.X-Evolution Refuge: An X variant needs actual qualified antibody status and its recorded individual profile. Shelter does not create an X-Antibody or make all Knights share one allegiance.
protocols.Liberator and New Horizons: Cards, match statistics, avatars and living partners are distinct. Use the selected game's actual format; printed moves and rewards do not transfer automatically into physical partner ownership.
protocols.File City Restoration Lands: Use the selected Digimon World state's actual recruitment and care rules. Service work does not transfer partner ownership, and its lifespan cycle is not imposed on an Adventure visitor.
protocols.Floatia and Next Order Frontier: The source's two-partner and rebirth systems apply only to eligible selected origins. Track each actual individual separately; an Adventure visitor is not issued a compulsory second partner.
protocols.Digital City and Digi-Beetle Sectors: World 2 vehicle, sector and party systems need actual compatible equipment and selected rules. The source's Server sectors are distinct from Adventure's Server Continent.
protocols.Asuka and Amaterasu Online Servers: World 3 account, representation and party systems stay within the selected source state. Account access does not prove consent or physical presence.
protocols.Digital Card Battle Arenas: Use the chosen Digital Card Battle format rather than combining unrelated TCG or Liberator rules. A card represents its match effect, not a physically owned living partner.
protocols.Story DigiFarm and Union Lands: Choose the Story game and date before using scan, farm, party or evolution rules. A scan record is distinct from an Adventure partner's actual living identity and consent.
protocols.Lost Evolution Tree Lands: A restored plate repairs its authenticated source record. A living partner still needs actual species eligibility, bond, compatible device, resources and earned progress.
protocols.EDEN and Hudie Network: Human bodies, EDEN accounts, avatars and Digimon cores are separate subjects. Eater-related and bodily incidents need actual source-specific expertise rather than a generic attribute cure.
protocols.Survive Mistlands: The chosen source route, actual relationships and voluntary negotiation determine progress. Do not impose a fixed tragedy or transfer an established Kemonogami relationship to the visitor.
protocols.ReDigitize Restoration Frontier: Choose Re:Digitize or Decode and the actual edition's compatible rules. Its File City is distinct from another game's similarly named city.
protocols.Adventure 2020 Frontiers: The reboot cast keeps histories distinct from the original Adventure team. Shared names, species and ancient-war motifs do not merge source timelines.
protocols.Seekers Urban Network: Mindlink needs actual source-compatible hardware, partner consent, monitoring and verified release. It is not unlimited mind reading or permanent inheritance of every linked skill.
protocols.Iliad and Time Stranger: Time travel is a bounded source mechanism with verified eras, identities and return. Olympus XII, Royal Knights, Titans and ADAMAS are distinct powers with dated roles.
protocols.Golden Digimental Highlands: Miracles and Destiny personal Crest paths are campaign additions separate from golden Armor Digimentals. Virtue, authentic custody and species compatibility remain distinct.
protocols.Memory Fault Frontier: Measure suppression, imposed control, recognition loss and ordinary equipment failure separately. A survivor can choose their current name and the scope of any repair.
protocols.Kernel and Deep Archives: The older maintenance-fault theory is a campaign hypothesis. Identify information, recoverable remnants and actual living cores separately; protect consent and a bounded stop-and-return method.
